$$
\text{Annual Return} = \frac{98.55 - 95.42}{95.42} = \frac{3.13}{95.42} \approx 0.0328 \text{ or } 3.28\%
$$

Next, calculate the Sharpe Ratio using the formula:

$$
\text{Sharpe Ratio} = \frac{\text{Return} - \text{Risk-Free Rate}}{\text{Standard Deviation}} = \frac{0.0328 - 0.0226}{0.1121} = \frac{0.0102}{0.1121} \approx 0.0909
$$

Rounding to three decimal places, the Sharpe Ratio is approximately **0.091**.

Final Answer: 0.091
